entities.text: Sabbisetti Murali Krishna vs State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4012 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, in C.C.No.339 of 2019, on the file of Court of the Special Judicial First Class Magistrate for Excise, Eluru.

entities.text: Court of the Special Judicial First Class Magistrate for Excise, Eluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Section 273 of IPC and Section 54 read with 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Raja ReddyKoneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.339 of 2019, on the file of Court of the Special Judicial First Class Magistrate for Excise, Eluru for the offences under Section 273 of IPC and Section 54 read with 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
__________________________ D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date:11.07.2019 Ssv HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No. 4012 of 2019 Date:11.7.2019 ssv Sabbisetti Murali Krishna vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160930472/
